items.title: Announcing Rust 1.99.1
items.blurb: The Rust team has published a new point release of Rust, 1.99.1. Rust is a programming language that is empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

items.title: 11 year old unsoundness bugs found in Rust borrow checker
Demoting i686 Windows targets to std-only
items.blurb: With Rust 1.100.0, the following changes to 32-bit Windows targets will happen: i686-pc-windows-msvc Tier 1 with host tools target will be demoted to Tier 1 without host tools.

items.title: Announcing Rust 1.99.0
items.blurb: The Rust team is happy to announce a new version of Rust, 1.99.0. Rust is a programming language empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

items.title: What agents mean for Rust (and vice versa)
Github Migrates Copilot Runtime to Rust with AI-Assisted Rewrite
items.blurb: GitHub migrated more than 800,000 lines of Copilot runtime code from TypeScript and Node.js to Rust in about 14.5 weeks using AI-assisted development.

items.title: Announcing a Maintainer in Residence: Scott Schafer for the Cargo team
items.blurb: At the end of August, we announced our first Maintainers in Residence, Rust Project contributors who are funded for their upstream contributions and maintenance work from the Rust Foundation Maintainers Fund (RFMF).

items.title: The DelightQL Query Language
items.blurb: Hey all, I would like to present a programming language I have been developing for many years called delightql.
